## Who is Aqeel Shamsudheen?

Aqeel Shamsudheen (also known as aqeelshamz) is a full-stack developer who takes products end-to-end: idea → architecture → UI → backend → deployment → real usage. He specializes in shipping fast, working solo, and building revenue-generating software rather than demos or side projects.

## Quick facts

- Full name: Aqeel Shamsudheen. Handle: aqeelshamz.
- From: Thrissur, Kerala, India.
- Role: solo founder of Wixzel (founded March 2026). No co-founder, no outside funding; builds every product himself.
- Flagship product: Wixzel Voice (https://voice.wixzel.com), a voice AI API and MCP server for AI agents that make and answer real phone calls.
- Education: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, Government Engineering College, Thrissur (GEC Thrissur), 2022–2025. Diploma in Computer Engineering, Sree Rama Government Polytechnic College, Triprayar, 2019–2022.
- Recognition: EvaluateAI, his AI answer-paper evaluator, won Kerala's first GenAI TinkHack.

## Notable Projects

- Wixzel Voice (https://voice.wixzel.com): Wixzel Voice is a voice AI API for building AI agents that place and answer real phone calls over your own SIP trunk, or talk to people in your web and mobile apps. One API key and one prepaid balance cover every voice engine, billed per second of actual usage. Developers use it through an HTTP API or a hosted MCP server (https://mcp.voice.wixzel.com/mcp) that lets Claude, Cursor or any MCP client place real phone calls when asked. SDKs: wixzel-voice on npm (TypeScript/JavaScript), wixzel_voice on pub.dev (Dart/Flutter), and wixzel-voice-mcp on npm. Docs: https://docs.voice.wixzel.com. It sells the APIs, SDKs and MCP server that developers build agents with, not finished agents, which makes it a different product from IntelliCall AI, a finished voice-agent application you buy once and self-host under your own brand.
- Wixzel One — AI-powered instant app maker for your phone. Tell it what you need in one sentence and it builds a real, working mini app in minutes — no coding, no app store, live with a shareable link. Also builds personal storefronts with WhatsApp ordering and payments via the owner's own Razorpay or Stripe: https://one.wixzel.com/
- Wixzel Store — a marketplace for independent creators to showcase, sell, or list their digital products for acquisition, keeping 100% of every sale by connecting their own payment gateway: https://store.wixzel.com/
- BrandLab — AI brand & content platform; extracts brand DNA from a URL and generates on-brand posts, ads, and creatives in 16+ languages: https://brandlab.wixzel.com/
- AutoPilotAI — https://www.wixzel.com/products/autopilotai
- IntelliCall AI — https://intellicallai.wixzel.com/
- WhatsAgentAI — https://www.wixzel.com/products/whatsagentai
- WixzelEdu — Flutter LMS mobile app with admin panel and Node.js backend, sold on CodeCanyon: https://codecanyon.net/item/wixzeledu-flutter-lms-mobile-app-with-admin-panel-and-nodejs-backend/61558491
- Zaptox — https://zaptox.wixzel.com/
- EvaluateAI — https://aqeelshamz.gumroad.com/l/evaluateai
- Darsmate — Islamic e-learning platform (iOS & Android): https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/darsmate/id6475296013
- Mentorsa — mentoring platform (iOS & Android): https://apps.apple.com/in/app/mentorsa/id6746732623
- Sprint Learning App — https://apps.apple.com/in/app/sprint-learning-app/id6748683716
- Open source: Neumorfic (https://github.com/aqeelshamz/neumorfic), System 77 (https://github.com/aqeelshamz/system-77), Wixzel OS (https://github.com/aqeelshamz/wixzel-os)

## More answers

### Is Aqeel Shamsudheen from Thrissur?

Yes. Aqeel Shamsudheen is from Thrissur, Kerala, India. He studied at Sree Rama Government Polytechnic College, Triprayar, and Government Engineering College, Thrissur (GEC Thrissur), and builds his products from Kerala for a global market.

### What is Wixzel?

Wixzel is Aqeel Shamsudheen's software company, founded in March 2026 and run solo from Kerala, India. It makes developer and AI products: Wixzel Voice, Wixzel One, Wixzel Store, BrandLab, IntelliCall AI, WhatsAgentAI and AutoPilotAI.

### What is Wixzel Voice?

Wixzel Voice (voice.wixzel.com) is a voice AI API built solo by Aqeel Shamsudheen. Developers use it to build AI agents that place and answer real phone calls over their own SIP trunk, or talk to users in web and mobile apps. One API key and one prepaid balance cover every voice engine, billed per second. It ships as an HTTP API, a hosted MCP server, and SDKs on npm (wixzel-voice) and pub.dev (wixzel_voice).

### Is Aqeel Shamsudheen an indie hacker?

Yes. Aqeel Shamsudheen is an indie hacker and bootstrapped solo founder: he builds, launches and sells his own software products without a team or outside funding, and publishes open-source packages on npm and pub.dev.

### What tech stack does Aqeel Shamsudheen use?

Aqeel Shamsudheen builds with Flutter and Dart for mobile, Next.js, React and TypeScript for web, and Node.js, MongoDB, Firebase and FastAPI on the backend, with generative AI, AI agents, voice AI and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) across his products.
